_metadata.description: Correlation engine, digest, score, and experiment framework requirements

requirements.title: Automated correlation analysis
requirements.description: Background job runs daily to discover correlations between event types across domains. Uses Pearson correlation for continuous variables, chi-squared for categorical.

requirements.title: Statistical significance tracking
requirements.description: Correlations include p-value and confidence interval. Only surfaces correlations with p < 0.05. Tracks correlation stability over time (new vs confirmed).

requirements.title: Configurable minimum threshold
requirements.description: User-configurable minimum sample size before generating correlations. Default: 14 data points. Prevents spurious correlations from limited data. UI shows 'needs more data' for insufficient samples.

requirements.title: Weekly digest generation
requirements.description: Every Sunday 6pm, generate 'What Changed?' digest. Compare current week to rolling 4-week baseline. Show: domain-level deltas, new correlations discovered, Lifestyle Score trend. Delivery: in-app notification.

requirements.title: Lifestyle Score calculation
requirements.description: Daily score 0-100 computed from all active domains. Domain weights: sleep (high), exercise (high), diet (medium), nootropics (medium), socialization (low). Weights adjustable per user. Score calculated at midnight for previous day.

requirements.title: Experiment definition
requirements.description: Users define N=1 experiments with: hypothesis, intervention event type, measurement event type, duration (days), baseline period (days). Experiments can span multiple domains. Events tagged with hypothesis_id.

requirements.title: Experiment tracking
requirements.description: Dashboard tracks experiment progress: days remaining, compliance rate (intervention events logged), measurement completeness. Daily brief includes experiment reminders.

requirements.title: Experiment outcome reports
requirements.description: On experiment completion, generates report: baseline vs intervention comparison, statistical significance, effect size, recommendation (continue/stop/inconclusive).
